s1.quote: As the top of the ship is in only about 30 metres (100 ft) of water … sank quickly into 50 metres (165 ft) of water.

s2.quote: sits upright on her keel in 50 metres (165′) of water.

summary.text: A large cruise liner that burned and sank off Grenada in 1961, now sitting upright on the seabed. Its upper decks begin near 30 m and the keel rests at about 50 m, making it a deep wreck dive.
